verses.text: All you people who live on islands in the ocean and in other distant areas,
When I grew up, he caused my messages to be like [SIM] a sharp sword.
He said to me, “You will serve my Israeli people,
I replied, “My work has been useless;
Yahweh formed me when I was in my mother’s womb in order that I would serve him;
He says to me,
Yahweh, the one who saves us,
This is also what Yahweh says:
I will say to those who were captured and ◄exiled/taken to Babylonia►,
They will not be hungry or thirsty any more;
And I will cause the mountains to become as though they were level roads,
My people will return from far away;
Because of what Yahweh has promised to do,
The people of Jerusalem say,
But Yahweh replies,
Note that I have written your names on the palms of my hands;
Soon your children will be returning there (OR, Those who rebuild your city will work more quickly than those who destroyed it),
You will look around and see
Your land has been ruined and caused to become desolate/abandoned [DOU],
The children who were born while you were ◄exiled/in Babylonia► [MET] will return to Jerusalem and say,
Then you will think to yourselves [MTY],
This is what Yahweh our God says:
Kings will serve you and will tutor/teach your children,
There is no one [RHQ] who can snatch valuable things from a soldier who has captured those things in a war;
But Yahweh says this:
And I will cause your enemies to destroy themselves [MET]
